posts.title: New preprint on arXiv!
posts.description: My paper, “Improving the efficiency of infectious disease prevention trials using negative control outcome event times”, is now available on arXiv. We investigate how adjusting for negative control infection times can improve the efficiency of prevention efficacy estimates against a target infection time through overlapping exposure mechanisms.
